description: For every first-order sentence \(\sigma\), its inclusion in the second-order language is true under full semantics exactly when the first-order structure satisfies \(\sigma\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.fullRealize_ofSentence.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w}
  [L.Structure M] (a : ℕ → M) (r : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.RelationAssignment M)
  (φ : L.Sentence) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.fullRealize a r
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.ofSentence φ) ↔
    M ⊨ φ
